Metadata.description: The central catalogue for OMSI 2 mods: buses, maps, repaints, objects, sounds and tools – with requirements, versions and links to the original sources.

sections.heading: Controller
sections.body: [Name and contact details of the controller]

sections.heading: Technically necessary data (to be reviewed)
sections.body: When the site is accessed, the server processes technically necessary connection data. A cookie (NEXT_LOCALE) is set to remember the language. For reports, the IP address is briefly used in memory as a hash to limit abuse and is not stored.

sections.heading: User accounts (to be reviewed)
sections.body: For an account we store the email address, username, display name, preferred language and a hashed password. For each sign-in session, the IP address and browser identifier are stored to detect abuse; they are deleted together with the session. A technically necessary session cookie is set for signing in. For confirmation and password emails as well as notifications about moderation decisions on your own projects, the email address is transmitted to the email service provider [add provider].

sections.heading: External links
sections.body: Clicks on external download links are counted without personal reference. After the redirect, the privacy policy of the respective provider applies.

sections.heading: Further information
sections.body: [Legal bases, retention periods, hosting provider, data subject rights and the right to lodge a complaint must be added.]

sections.heading: Scope
sections.body: OMSI Mod Hub is a catalogue that describes projects for OMSI 2 and links to external download sources. No mod files are hosted.

sections.heading: External content
sections.body: The providers of external pages and files are responsible for their content. [Liability provisions must be added and reviewed.]

Email.resetSubject: Reset your password – OMSI Mod Hub
Email.resetBody:
Hello {name},

you can set a new password for OMSI Mod Hub using this link:

{url}

The link is valid for one hour. If you did not request this, you can ignore this email – your password stays unchanged.

approve.subject: Approved: {title} – OMSI Mod Hub
approve.body:
Hello {name},

your project “{title}” has been reviewed and is now publicly listed in the catalogue:

{url}

Thank you for your contribution!

reject.subject: Not approved: {title} – OMSI Mod Hub

hide.subject: Hidden: {title} – OMSI Mod Hub

unhide.subject: Visible again: {title} – OMSI Mod Hub

Email.changeEmailConfirmSubject: Change your email address – OMSI Mod Hub
Email.changeEmailConfirmBody:
Hi {name},

someone asked to change the email address of your OMSI Mod Hub account to {newEmail}. If that was you, confirm the change with this link:

{url}

After that, we will send another link to the new address. The link is valid for 24 hours.

If that wasn't you, ignore this email and consider changing your password. Your address stays the same.
Email.changeEmailVerifySubject: Confirm your new email address – OMSI Mod Hub
Email.changeEmailVerifyBody:
Hi {name},

please confirm this address as the new email address of your OMSI Mod Hub account:

{url}

The address is only changed after that. The link is valid for 24 hours. If you didn't request this, you can ignore this email.
Email.accountDeletedSubject: Your account has been deleted – OMSI Mod Hub
Email.accountDeletedBody:
Hi {name},

your OMSI Mod Hub account has been deleted, together with your creator profile and your projects.

If you didn't do this yourself, please contact us using the details on the website.
